 // Will be set to nx if not specified\n    size_t nz = 0;  // Will be set to nx if not specified\n    int iterations = 10;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-x\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            nx = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-y\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            ny = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-z\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            nz = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-i\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            iterations = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    if (ny == 0) ny = nx;\n    if (nz == 0) nz = nx;\n    \n    printf(\"3D Stencil Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Grid size: %zu x %zu x %zu\\n\", nx, ny, nz);\n    printf(\"Iterations: %d\\n\", iterations);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    size_t gridSize = nx * ny * nz;\n    \n    // Allocate device grids (double buffering)\n    Real* d_grid1 = nullptr;\n    Real* d_grid2 = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_grid1, gridSize * sizeof(Real)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_grid2, gridSize * sizeof(Real)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(d_grid2, 0, gridSize * sizeof(Real)));\n    \n    // Initialize\n    printf(\"Initializing grid...\\n\");\n    launchInit(d_grid1, nx, ny, nz);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n    \n    // Run stencil iterations\n    printf(\"Running stencil computation...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    for (int iter = 0; iter < iterations; ++iter) {\n        if (iter % 2 == 0) {\n            launchStencil(d_grid1, d_grid2, nx, ny, nz);\n        } else {\n            launchStencil(d_grid2, d_grid1, nx, ny, nz);\n        }\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n    \n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n    \n    printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n    \n    // Calculate performance metrics\n    double cellUpdates = (double)((nx-2) * (ny-2) * (nz-2)) * iterations;\n    double mcups = cellUpdates / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e6;  // Million cell updates per second\n    printf(\"Performance: %.3f MCellUpdates/s\\n\", mcups);\n    \n    // Copy final grid back to host for output / validation\n    Real* d_final = (iterations % 2 == 0) ? d_grid1 : d_grid2;\n    int exitCode = 0;\n    if (printResults || validate) {\n        std::vector<Real> finalGrid(gridSize);\n        if (gridSize > 0) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(finalGrid.data(), d_final, gridSize * sizeof(Real), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n        }\n        \n        // Print results for external validation\n        if (printResults) {\n            print_results(finalGrid, \"Grid\");\n        }\n        \n        // Validation\n        if (validate) {\n            printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n            bool valid = validateResult(finalGrid, nx, ny, nz);\n            \n            if (valid) {\n                printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            } else {\n                printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n                exitCode = 1;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_grid1));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_grid2));\n    return exitCode;\n}\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/stencil3d_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_cuda_r4/stencil3d/stencil3d.cpp","exists":true,"truncated":false},"title":"home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/stencil3d_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_cuda_r4/stencil3d/stencil3d.cpp","time":{"start":1793064752103,"end":1793064752171}},"metadata":{"anthropic":{"caller":{"type":"direct"}}},"id":"prt_17afcc734001Zivp9pwqwZNGat","sessionID":"ses_e8504b9d9ffe70eoZxbLxW4ENF","messageID":"msg_17afc87b2001CrO0qA8YKitkR6"}}
